status: post-outcome referee-led V3 pre-result contract; immutable before any Gate 2 dynamic result execution

dependency_release.role: narrow Gate 1 release for certified numerical targets only

focal_target_source_audit.role: binds every reported focal value to the certified A1 reference path

requirements_seed.role: requirements Y01-Y05, N04, Y08, and T05

calendar.rule: equal weight per actually observed calendar month; omit transition December 2022; never interpolate October 2025 or complete partial quarters

static_nuisance.pooled: occupation and calendar-month fixed effects plus Webb-z by post
static_nuisance.family_month: occupation and family-by-calendar-month fixed effects plus Webb-z by post

models.dynamic_nuisance: same structure-specific fixed effects; Q2-Q5 and Webb-z interacted with quarters; 2022Q4 omitted

functionals.S: certified static Q5-by-post coefficient relative to Q1-by-post
functionals.P: equal-observed-post-month average of quarterly Q5 coefficients relative to published omitted 2022Q4
functionals.D: equal-observed-post-month average minus equal-observed-pre-month average, with the two observed 2022Q4 months entering the pre mean at coefficient zero under published normalization
functionals.conditioning_movement: family_month minus unconditioned, separately for S, P, D and the P-S and D-S gaps

reparameterization.coefficient_rule: beta_new = B beta_old over every quarter and all five interacted components
reparameterization.reference_rebase_ground_truth: B is the unique free_rebase_matrix(period_labels, old_reference, new_reference) derived independently from labels
reparameterization.generic_linear_transform_scope: arbitrary invertible transforms may pass only generic linear equivalence and cannot certify a reference rebase
reparameterization.common_draw_rule: transform the full occupation influence/common-draw vector, never a pointwise covariance submatrix
reparameterization.available_now: full certified dynamic coefficient vectors only

nesting.identity: X_static = X_dynamic A on the exact same active rows and nuisance normalization
nesting.projection_check: refit grouped-binomial static criterion to pseudo-young total*p_dynamic and pseudo-older total*(1-p_dynamic)
missing_objects: full static design and ordered rows
full dynamic design and ordered rows
nesting map or sufficient columns to construct it

nulls_per_window: all selected coefficients equal the original 2022Q4 reference
all selected coefficients equal one another within the selected block
pretrend.rank_rule: require finite symmetric positive-semidefinite restricted covariance; use one eigendecomposition and one scale-relative cutoff for retained inverse eigenvalues, covariance rank, Wald statistic, degrees of freedom, and diagnostics; block rather than project away a target outside the retained covariance range using a dimensionless null-residual tolerance equal to the square root of the eigenvalue tolerance
influence_diagnostics: leave-one-quarter or declared leave-block diagnostics that rebuild the null on remaining labels, including anchor replacement
persistent level, equal-elapsed-quarter drift, and seasonal mean contrasts
pretrend.interpretation: leave-out Wald changes are not additive quarter contributions; no date-based claim that COVID drives rejection; no p-value-selected prewindow

requirements.Y01: IMPLEMENTED_POINT_ONLY; paired conditioning uncertainty blocked by missing cross-model influence/common draws
requirements.Y02: IMPLEMENTED_UNRUN; exact nesting, score, and pseudo-stock projection require missing bound design/fitted objects
requirements.Y03: IMPLEMENTED_COEFFICIENT_ONLY; covariance/influence/common-draw rebasing and numerical joint-Wald invariance are blocked by missing objects
requirements.Y04: IMPLEMENTED_DEFINITIONS_ONLY; numerical tests require covariance and inferential procedure objects
requirements.Y05: IMPLEMENTED_DEFINITIONS_ONLY; simultaneous and leave-block diagnostics require influence/common draws
requirements.N04: SIX A1 coding-stable/seasonality models are numerically certified; this does not supply onset-grid or endpoint fits
requirements.Y08: UNMET: requires 16 fresh onset fits (8 starts November 2022 through June 2023 times 2 structures) with same-objective numerical certification; the dependency map complete_onset label binds only six post-2020/seasonality fits and is insufficient
requirements.T05: UNMET: requires 2 through-December-2024 fits (pooled and family-month) with fixed preperiod labels and same-objective numerical certification

execution.mode: preflight point reconciliation only; no authoritative result claim

outputs.identity_rule: any material output receives yaxresult_v1 SHA-256 identity over spec_id, logical key, and artifact hash
